## Description

Uses Bayesian Structural Time Series models to estimate the causal impact of macroeconomic shocks or corporate announcements on asset returns, isolating abnormal returns.

## Where it may fit

Unscheduled geopolitical events, central bank surprise announcements, major regulatory shifts.

## Vehicles

Global macro hedge funds, event-driven trading desks, quantitative asset allocators.

## Required data

Daily/hourly asset returns, macroeconomic leading indicators, control asset time series.

## Caveats

Requires careful selection of synthetic control assets that are unaffected by the target event.
